method: Qualitative, evidence-tiered inquiry order; no numeric score is assigned because no provider has responded to an identical combined scope. Ranks 15–22 are tied and listed alphabetically. This is not a verified performance ranking or a hiring recommendation.

criteria.basis: CSLB status, B/C-36/C-9 definitions and license-detail records are the basis for trade fit; classifications alone do not prove performance.
A company-published tub waste-and-overflow ceiling-access case is useful evidence but is self-reported and not proof of acceptance of this exact job.
